
  Working directory · resume
  Session = latest cwd recorded in the resumed session
  Current = your current working directory

› 1. Use session directory (/home/user/Projects/example-service-worktrees/instance-worktree-checkouts-for-codex/
     sibling-worktree-B)
  2. Use current directory (/home/user/Projects/example-service-worktrees/instance-worktree-checkouts-for-codex/
     current-worktree-A)
  3. Always use session directory
  4. Always use current directory
